title: Crystal Garden
description: Towering prismatic crystals rise from the earth like ancient trees, their faceted surfaces splitting light into cascading rainbows. A low harmonic tone resonates through the formation, and fine crystalline dust drifts in the still air like luminous pollen.

choices.label: Harvest crystal shards
choices.description: Carefully break off smaller growths from the base of the formations.

outcomes.text: The smaller crystals snap cleanly from the base. They chime like bells as you tuck them away.
You find an unusually dense cluster — the shards here are richer in color and hum with stored light.
A crystal shatters violently as you strike it, releasing a blinding prismatic flash that leaves your party reeling.

choices.label: Collect the resonant dust
choices.description: Sweep up the sparkling dust that gathers in the hollows between crystals.

outcomes.text: The dust is plentiful in the sheltered hollows. You fill several pouches with the glittering powder.
Beneath the dust you uncover a cache of coins left by a previous traveler, half-buried in crystalline sediment.
The dust swirls into a miniature vortex as you disturb it, coating everything but yielding only a thin layer.

choices.label: Leave the garden undisturbed
choices.description: The crystals seem almost alive. It feels wrong to take from them.

outcomes.text: You watch the light play across the formations for a long moment, then move on. Some beauty is best left intact.
